claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN trains the VGG16 network 9 times faster than R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Fast R-CNN trains the very deep VGG16 network 9× faster than R-CNN

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN achieves a higher mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012 than R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: achieves a higher mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012

claims.claim_text_normalized: R-CNN training is a multi-stage pipeline that is slow and inelegant.
Fast R-CNN uses a single-stage training algorithm with a multi-task loss.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose a single-stage training algorithm that jointly learns to classify object proposals and refine their spatial locations.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fine-tuning convolutional layers in VGG16 improves mean average precision.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Fine-tuning conv layers in VGG16 improves mAP

claims.claim_text_normalized: Multi-task training improves classification accuracy over training for classification alone.
claims.evidence_quote_short: multi-task training improves pure classification accuracy relative to training for classification alone

claims.claim_text_normalized: Single-scale detection performs almost as well as multi-scale detection for deep convolutional networks.
claims.evidence_quote_short: single-scale detection performs almost as well as multi-scale detection

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using more object proposals does not always improve detection accuracy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: swamping the deep classifier with more proposals does not help, and even slightly hurts, accuracy
